name: React
certifications: No official React certification; assessed by capstone project
OpenJS JSNSD for Node.js work alongside React

beginner.summary: For developers with basic HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Covers modern JavaScript for React, components and JSX, props and state, events, lists, forms, effects, fetching data, routing, styling, context and testing, ending with a complete single-page application.
prerequisites: Knows JavaScript variables, functions, arrays and objects
Can use a terminal and npm
outcomes: Build React components with props, state and hooks
Fetch, display and update data from APIs
Add routing, forms and styling to single-page apps
Test components and deploy a React application

days.topic: React Setup and Modern JavaScript Refresher
subtopics: What React is and why teams use it
Installing Node.js and creating a project with Vite
Project structure and the dev server
days.lab_task: Create a React project with Vite, run it, and complete ten JavaScript exercises with destructuring, spread, array methods and async/await that the course will use.
checks: App opens in the browser with hot reload

days.lab_task: Break a provided product page design into components, build them with JSX and inspect the component tree with React Developer Tools.
days.deliverable: Component tree diagram and working page
checks: Return two elements without a wrapper div

days.lab_task: Build a product list where each card receives product props and an onAdd callback, typed with TypeScript, and a layout component that renders children.
checks: Parent receives the product through the callback

days.lab_task: Build a shopping cart with add, remove and quantity change, keep items in state immutably and show the total, then fix a provided bug caused by mutating state.
days.deliverable: Cart component and bug fix note
checks: Count increases by three with functional updates

days.lab_task: Add a show-details toggle, an empty-cart message, a loading spinner and keyboard-accessible buttons to the shop.
checks: No rendering of 0 or false by mistake

subtopics: Performance of large lists in brief
days.lab_task: Render a product list with search, category filter and sort, use stable keys and show a bug caused by index keys when reordering.
days.deliverable: List component and key bug demonstration
checks: Correct products in the right order
Input values move to the wrong rows, demonstrated

subtopics: Text, select, checkbox and radio inputs
days.lab_task: Build a checkout form with controlled inputs, validation for email, phone and address, clear error messages and accessible labels, then rebuild it with React Hook Form.
checks: Error shown next to the field
Less code and fewer re-renders with React Hook Form

subtopics: Effects that should not be effects
days.lab_task: Add a countdown offer timer with clean-up, save the cart to localStorage and remove two unnecessary effects from a provided component.
checks: Leave the page with the timer running
Timer cleared with no console warnings

subtopics: A first look at TanStack Query
days.lab_task: Load products from a REST API with loading and error states, abort requests when the search changes, then replace the code with TanStack Query and compare.
checks: Only the latest result is shown

days.lab_task: Add routes for home, product list, product detail, cart and a 404 page, with a shared layout and a protected account page.
checks: Detail page loads the right product
Open the account page logged out

days.lab_task: Style the shop with Tailwind, make it responsive for phone and desktop, add dark mode and restyle one component with CSS Modules for comparison.
checks: Layout adapts with no horizontal scroll

days.lab_task: Move the cart and the logged-in user into context providers, remove prop drilling and show a re-render problem fixed by splitting context.
checks: Add to cart from a deep component
Cart badge updates without passing props
No props passed only to forward them

days.lab_task: Rewrite the cart with useReducer and typed actions, add undo for the last change and unit-test the reducer.

days.topic: Refs and Working with the DOM
subtopics: forwardRef and ref as a prop
When refs are the wrong tool
days.lab_task: Focus the search box on load, scroll to the first form error on submit and wrap a third-party chart library in a component with a ref.
checks: Page scrolls to the first error

days.lab_task: Extract useDebounce, useLocalStorage and useProducts hooks from the shop, use them in two components and test them.
checks: API called once after typing stops

days.lab_task: Write tests for the product list, cart and checkout form using user events and MSW for the API, and reach 80 percent coverage.
checks: Make the API return an error

subtopics: Code splitting with lazy and Suspense
days.lab_task: Profile the shop, fix a slow list with memo, lazy-load the checkout route and improve the Lighthouse performance score.
days.deliverable: Profiles before and after and Lighthouse reports
checks: Checkout code in a separate chunk

days.lab_task: Audit the shop with axe and a screen reader, fix the issues, build an accessible modal with focus trapping and add accessibility lint rules.
days.deliverable: Audit results, fixes and modal component
checks: Open the modal with the keyboard
Focus moves into it and returns on close

days.lab_task: Build the shop for production, deploy it from Git with preview deployments for branches, fix deep-link routing on the host and add error tracking.
days.deliverable: Live URL, preview URL and error report
checks: Open a deep link on the live site

days.lab_task: Build and deploy a typed shop with product search, filters, routing, a cart in context, a validated checkout form, API data with loading and error states, tests and accessibility checks, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, live URL, test report and a 10-minute demo
checks: All pass with at least 75 percent coverage
Run axe on the main pages
Complete a purchase on the live site
Order flow works end to end
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one app

intermediate.summary: For React developers who build apps with hooks. Covers TypeScript patterns, state management with TanStack Query and Zustand or Redux Toolkit, advanced forms, Next.js with the App Router and Server Components, authentication, performance, design systems, testing at every level, internationalisation and CI/CD.
prerequisites: Builds React apps with hooks, routing and data fetching
Uses TypeScript at a basic level
outcomes: Structure medium and large React codebases
Manage server and client state cleanly
Build full applications with Next.js, Server Components and server actions
Test, optimise and ship React apps through CI/CD

days.topic: Project Structure and TypeScript Patterns for React
days.lab_task: Restructure a provided messy app into feature folders, type every component and hook strictly, add a generic table component and set up lint and format rules.
checks: Use the generic table with two data types

days.lab_task: Move all API calls to TanStack Query with typed query keys, add optimistic updates with rollback for the cart, infinite scroll for products and invalidation after checkout.
checks: Fail the cart update on the server

days.topic: Client State with Zustand and Redux Toolkit
days.lab_task: Implement UI and cart state once with Zustand and once with Redux Toolkit, persist it, use selectors to avoid re-renders and compare the two.
Build a multi-step onboarding form with field arrays, Zod validation shared with the API, file upload and server error mapping.
checks: Return a server error for one field

days.lab_task: Port the shop to Next.js with the App Router, layouts, loading and error states, dynamic product routes and page metadata, and deploy it.
checks: Rendered with its own title and description

days.topic: React Server Components and Server Actions
days.lab_task: Render the product list as a server component, stream slow reviews with Suspense, add to cart with a server action and revalidate the cart page.
checks: Product list code not shipped to the browser
Load a page with slow reviews
Page shows first, reviews stream in
Call the server action with invalid input

days.topic: Authentication and Authorisation in React Apps
days.lab_task: Add sign-in with email and Google, protect account pages and server actions, show admin features only to admins and test that the server enforces the rules.
checks: Call an admin server action as a normal user

days.lab_task: Build a compound Tabs component, a headless Combobox with a hook, and a polymorphic Button, and document their APIs.
checks: Use the Combobox with the keyboard

days.lab_task: Build a small design system with tokens, five components and Storybook stories, add visual tests and publish it as a package used by the shop.
checks: Every component has stories and docs
Install the package in the shop

days.lab_task: Render a 10,000-row list with virtualisation, keep search responsive with transitions, fix Core Web Vitals on the home page and set a performance budget in CI.
days.deliverable: Profiles, Web Vitals and budget configuration

days.topic: GraphQL and Typed API Clients in React
subtopics: REST versus GraphQL for front ends
Generated types with GraphQL Code Generator
days.lab_task: Connect the shop to a GraphQL API with Apollo and generated types, generate a typed REST client from an OpenAPI spec for orders, and show compile errors when the API changes.
checks: Generated types cause compile errors where it is used
Normalised cache updates every view of it
objectives: Keep front end and API in step

days.topic: Error Handling and Resilience in the UI
days.lab_task: Add error boundaries per route, retries with back-off, an offline banner and Sentry logging, and test each error path.
checks: Boundary shows fallback and the rest of the page works
Banner shown and requests resume when back online

days.lab_task: Add integration tests for checkout with MSW and Playwright tests for sign-in and purchase, and run them in CI.
checks: Purchase flow passes in a headless browser
Tests block a breaking pull request
objectives: Test React apps at every level

days.lab_task: Translate the shop into English, Hindi and Arabic with plurals, formatted prices and dates, and a right-to-left layout for Arabic.
checks: All text translated and prices in INR format
"1 item" and "5 items" correct in each language

days.lab_task: Add list animations, a page transition and a drag-to-reorder list with Framer Motion, and respect reduced motion settings.
checks: No dropped frames on the test device

days.lab_task: Add live stock updates and a support chat with presence to the shop, handle reconnection and keep the cache in sync.
objectives: Sync real-time data with the cache

days.topic: Progressive Web Apps and Offline Support
days.lab_task: Make the shop installable with offline access to viewed products and background sync for cart changes made offline.

subtopics: Pipeline stages: lint, type-check, test, build
tools: LaunchDarkly or a feature flag library
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline with lint, type-check, tests and build, deploy previews per pull request, release behind a feature flag and roll back a bad release.
checks: All checks run and a preview URL is posted
Turn the flag on for 10 percent
Only that share sees the feature

subtopics: CSRF with server actions and APIs
days.lab_task: Find and fix four planted front-end vulnerabilities, add a Content Security Policy and security headers and scan dependencies.
checks: Inject a script through a product review

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Production Next.js Commerce App
subtopics: Server Components, server actions and auth
days.lab_task: Deliver a commerce app in Next.js with server components, server actions, authentication, a design system, localisation, strong Web Vitals, full tests and CI/CD with previews, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, live URL, test reports, Lighthouse report and a 15-minute demo
checks: All checks pass and a preview is deployed
Call a protected server action without rights
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one app

advanced.summary: For senior front-end engineers and architects. Covers React internals and concurrent rendering, advanced Server Components and caching, large-scale architecture and micro-frontends, monorepos, design systems at scale, advanced performance, state architecture, testing strategy, observability, security, accessibility programmes, React Native in brief and front-end leadership.
prerequisites: Ships production React or Next.js applications
Knows Server Components, testing and CI/CD
Leads code reviews or technical decisions
outcomes: Explain React internals and design for concurrent rendering
Architect large front ends with monorepos, micro-frontends and design systems
Engineer performance, security and observability at scale

days.topic: React Internals: Fibre, Reconciliation and Concurrent Rendering
days.lab_task: Build a tiny React-like renderer to understand reconciliation, then use profiling to explain how transitions keep a heavy page responsive.
checks: Render and update a list with the mini renderer
Urgent updates shown before the transition finishes

days.topic: Advanced Server Components, Caching and Data Architecture
subtopics: Choosing between server and client data fetching
days.lab_task: Design a data access layer for a content-heavy site, use tag-based revalidation, remove three request waterfalls and enable partial prerendering.
days.deliverable: Data layer, measurements and design notes
checks: Static shell served instantly with dynamic parts streamed

days.lab_task: Restructure a large provided codebase into feature modules with enforced dependency rules, write decision records and present the architecture in a review.
days.deliverable: Restructured code, dependency rules and decision records

subtopics: Monorepo tools: Turborepo, Nx, pnpm workspaces
days.lab_task: Combine two apps and a design system into a monorepo with shared packages, remote caching, affected-only CI and code owners.
checks: Only that app builds and tests

subtopics: Composition at build, server and runtime
days.lab_task: Split the shop into a shell and two micro-frontends with Module Federation, share React once, deploy one independently and measure the cost in bundle size.
days.deliverable: Micro-frontend set-up, deployment record and bundle analysis
checks: Shell picks up the change without redeploying
objectives: Judge when they are worth it

days.lab_task: Add multi-brand theming with tokens, release a breaking change with a codemod that upgrades consumers, and measure adoption across apps.
days.deliverable: Theming system, codemod and adoption report
checks: All components follow the new tokens
Run the codemod on a consumer app
App compiles on the new version
Usage of library components versus custom ones measured

days.lab_task: Collect real user Web Vitals, find the worst Interaction to Next Paint cause, move heavy work to a web worker and cut third-party script cost.
days.deliverable: RUM dashboard, fixes and before and after data
checks: INP and LCP shown by page
Long tasks removed from the main thread

subtopics: Server state, URL state and client state
days.lab_task: Model checkout as a state machine, keep filters in the URL, sync the cart across tabs and resolve an offline conflict.
days.deliverable: State machine, sync implementation and tests
checks: Send an invalid event to the machine
Change the cart in one tab

days.lab_task: Design a testing strategy for a large app, add a contract test with the API, shard Playwright across workers and quarantine flaky tests automatically.
days.deliverable: Strategy, contract test and CI results
checks: Moved out of the blocking suite with a ticket

days.lab_task: Add OpenTelemetry tracing from the browser to the API, error tracking with source maps, privacy-safe session replay and alerts on error spikes.
checks: One trace from browser to database

subtopics: Strict Content Security Policy with nonces
days.lab_task: Add a strict nonce-based CSP and Trusted Types, move tokens to a backend-for-frontend, block a malicious package with supply chain scanning and run a security review.
days.deliverable: Security configuration, BFF and review report
checks: No access tokens available to scripts
objectives: Use strict CSP and Trusted Types

subtopics: Automated, manual and assistive technology testing
days.lab_task: Run a full accessibility audit with automated, manual and screen reader testing, fix the top issues in the design system and produce a conformance report.
checks: Fixed across all apps using it

days.topic: Data-Heavy Interfaces: Tables, Dashboards and Large Forms
subtopics: Sorting, filtering and pagination on the server
days.lab_task: Build an admin dashboard with a 100,000-row server-paginated table, virtualised rows, live charts and a 150-field form with draft saving and keyboard navigation.
days.deliverable: Dashboard, table and form with performance results
checks: Server returns the right page quickly
objectives: Keep large tables and forms fast

subtopics: Sharing code between web and native
days.lab_task: Build a React Native version of the product list and cart with Expo, share types and API code with the web app and compare effort with a mobile web approach.
days.deliverable: Expo app, shared packages and comparison
checks: Types and API client used by both apps

days.topic: Server-Side Rendering at the Edge and Hosting Strategy
days.lab_task: Deploy the app on a managed platform and self-hosted in Docker behind a CDN, compare latency from three regions and monthly cost, and recommend one.
checks: Static assets served from the edge

days.topic: Migrations: Class Components, Legacy State and Framework Upgrades
days.lab_task: Migrate a legacy app with class components and old Redux, upgrade React and move two pages from Pages Router to App Router incrementally, with tests protecting behaviour.
days.deliverable: Migration plan, migrated code and test results

subtopics: Safety and moderation in the UI
days.lab_task: Build a product assistant in the shop that streams answers, renders product cards from tool calls, handles errors and rate limits, and is evaluated on 20 questions.
checks: Assistant shows product cards from a tool call

days.lab_task: Write a front-end technical strategy for an organisation with eight product teams, including tooling, platform support, standards and a 12-month roadmap, and present it.
Resolve four injected production issues (a hydration mismatch, a memory leak, a stale cache and a third-party script outage), find root causes and write runbooks.
checks: Write a runbook for third-party outages

days.lab_task: Deliver a front-end platform with a monorepo, multi-brand design system, two independently deployed apps, server data architecture, strict security, observability and a testing strategy, then present it to leadership.
days.deliverable: Platform repository, dashboards, test reports and a 20-minute presentation
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
